title: PHP 8.6.0 Released!
content:
The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 8.6.0. This release marks a major update to the PHP language.

PHP 8.6 comes with numerous improvements and new features such as:

See for more highlights and examples.what’s new in PHP 8.6

Source downloads for PHP 8.6.0 are available on our . Windows source and binaries are available on the . The list of changes is recorded in the . downloads pageWindows downloads pageChangeLog

The in the PHP Manual lists new features and backward-incompatible changes in detail. migration guide

Kudos to all the contributors and supporters!

  • Partial Function Application
  • Default values for readonly properties
  • New API for monitoring streamsIo\Poll
  • New functionclamp()
  • New class\Time\Duration
  • New enumSortDirection
